# @skillpet/chat

> SSE streaming AI chat panel component library for React & Vue 3.

## Docs

- [API Reference](https://chat.skill.pet/api.md): Frontend component API — types, props, hooks, queued send, attachment handling, and usage examples.
- [Backend Integration Guide](https://chat.skill.pet/backend-guide.md): HTTP API spec, SSE event protocol, message storage schema, System Prompt best practices.

- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@skillpet/chat-react
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@skillpet/chat-vue
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@skillpet/chat-core
- Demo: https://chat.skill.pet
- GitHub: https://github.com/skillpet/skillpet-chat
